acceptance_criteria.criterion: A Source Handling precondition failure that occurs before any provider dispatch can become possible does not irreversibly burn the authorization
acceptance_criteria.evidence: IssueSourceTransientIntakeBoundary.preflight() (source_handling_persistence.py) validates authority/provenance/retention/durable-payload conditions without persisting, and is invoked before ledger.claim() in GovernedIssueAgentExecutionService.execute(); test_preflight_failure_creates_no_ledger_row_and_allows_retry proves a failed preflight leaves no ledger row and no fallback dispatch.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add a side-effect-free Source Handling preflight on the existing IssueSourceTransientIntakeBoundary validating the same authority/provenance/retention/durable-payload conditions required by ingest without persisting evidence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: preflight() reuses the same _intake.prepare path, _require_coordinated_authority_database, resolve_pre_model_source_handling decision checks, _enforce_fact_persistence_restriction and validate_durable_payload as ingest, then connection.rollback() with no commit and no durable artifact; the third-party parse-test verifies no ledger row is created.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Run the preflight after issuer signature plus repository/owner plus pure mapping checks but before ledger.claim(...)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: issue_agent_execution.py places the preflight call after the document_id binding check and immediately before self._ledger.claim(), preserving the canonical ordering; a preflight failure therefore aborts before the CLAIMED state exists.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Keep the existing ingest(...) re-validation under its BEGIN IMMEDIATE write lock after the claim; do not replace the atomic durable-intake gate with a stale preflight result
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ingest() is unchanged and still re-resolves Source Handling under its own BEGIN IMMEDIATE write lock; preflight is strictly advisory and its result is not trusted as an intake gate, so a restrictive authority change between preflight and intake still fails closed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Do not weaken replay protection for an authorization that reached DISPATCHED or COMPLETED
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ledger.claim() replay semantics are untouched; test_crash_between_handoff_persistence_and_dispatch_cannot_duplicate and the duplicate-authorization rejection tests remain green against the preflight insertion.

defect_families.evidence: untrusted-temporal-authority: preflight samples the authority cutoff only after BEGIN IMMEDIATE via _authority_current_cutoff(connection, self._clock), so the caller cannot choose the cutoff; processed_at only times an artifact that preflight never persists. The preflight path cannot admit an authorization the authority has not approved.

transaction-snapshot-inconsistency: preflight executes its authority read under its own BEGIN IMMEDIATE write lock, and ingest retains its own independent lock, so no validating read and a dependent durable write can drift apart; the advisory preflight never feeds a stale snapshot into the atomic intake gate.

logical-identity-reuse: preflight validates reference.metadata via _validate_issue_metadata and derives evidence_document_id(reference) through the same canonical function as ingest; no caller-chosen identifier can displace an assigned identity and nothing is persisted at preflight time.

schema-fail-closed-incompleteness: preflight fails closed on any missing authority component by raising SourceHandlingBlockedError when retention_decision is not ALLOW, deletion lifecycle is blocking, durable dispositions are unavailable, or fact authority is missing; there is no permissive default.

nested-metadata-persistence-bypass: preflight enforces _enforce_fact_persistence_restriction and validate_durable_payload over the same canonical FACT/REGISTRY/POLICY artifacts as ingest and persists nothing itself, so no governed exclusion can be defeated through a secondary carrying surface.

monotonicity-and-restart-instability: preflight is side-effect-free (unconditional rollback), so a failed preflight advances no durable state and a restart cannot observe a half-claimed transition; the preflight-before-claim ordering is stable across the composition root and its tests.

authorization-replay: preflight validates authority without claiming; replay protection remains exactly the unchanged ledger.claim() behavior, and the retained tests prove a legitimately claimed replayed authorization is still rejected while a preflight-failed one can be retried without burning the authorization.

ready-without-complete-hostile-review: this candidate records the exact-head pre-ready hostile review covering all applicable recurring-defect families and the exigent adversarial dimensions as part of the same governed change set.

rendered-budget-not-raw-input-decides-dispatchability: preflight does not alter input-budget or route dispatch decisions; on failure no fallback runtime dispatch occurs (asserted in test_preflight_failure_creates_no_ledger_row_and_allows_retry) and the authoritative intake gate remains unchanged.

findings.evidence: Side-effect freedom of preflight: adversarial check confirmed preflight must acquire no durable state. preflight() takes the write lock only to sample a consistent authority snapshot and unconditionally rolls back (explicit rollback on both the success tail and exception tail) before closing, and test_preflight_failure_creates_no_ledger_row_and_allows_retry asserts no ledger row exists after a preflight failure.

Preflight ordering relative to ledger claim: adversarial check confirmed preflight must precede claim so a provision error cannot burn the authorization. issue_agent_execution.py invokes self._boundary.preflight(...) immediately before self._ledger.claim(...), after the identity binding check, satisfying the required correction ordering.

Caller-controlled cutoff: adversarial check confirmed the authority cutoff must not be caller-choosable. preflight derives authority_cutoff from _authority_current_cutoff(connection, self._clock) only after BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and processed_at is transitioned to an aware UTC timestamp and used only to time an artifact, never as authority.

Snapshot reuse across preflight and claim: adversarial check confirmed the advisory preflight result must never gate the atomic intake. ingest() is left unchanged and re-resolves Source Handling under its own BEGIN IMMEDIATE write lock, so a restrictive authority change between preflight and intake fails closed.
